title: 연구학교에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Research Plans and Research Results)
(1) The head of a research school shall submit a research plan to the competent Superintendent of Education within one month after the school is designated as a research school, and shall submit a report on the results of research conducted during the designated period at least one month before the period expires. Provided, however, that a permanent research school shall submit such reports to the Minister of Education through the Superintendent of Education having jurisdiction over the location of the school. [Amended on January 31, 2001; March 4, 2008; July 30, 2008; and March 23, 2013.]
(2) The Minister of Education or the Superintendent of Education shall make the research results public and ensure that the results are sufficiently utilized. [Amended on January 31, 2001; March 4, 2008; and March 23, 2013.]
